item.title: Nvidia: Research Scientist, AI and Systems Security - PhD New College Grad 2026
item.description:
locations
US, MA, Westford
US, CA, Santa Clara
time type
Full time

Posted Today
job requisition id
JR2025894
We are looking for a Research Scientist to advance security, safety, and privacy across three complementary research areas: (1) security of AI models and systems; (2) AI-enabled design and verification of secure computer systems; and (3) AI for cybersecurity. The first area includes making AI models, agents, data pipelines, runtimes, and accelerated computing platforms secure, safe, private, and resilient to attack, misuse, data leakage, and other failures. AI-enabled design and verification includes using AI, together with systems and formal techniques, to design, analyze, implement, and verify secure hardware and software systems. AI for cybersecurity includes applying AI to vulnerability discovery, secure systems development, threat detection, incident analysis, and automated defense.
Across these three areas, we aim to build secure, safe, and private systems from first principles by co-designing hardware, software, AI models, algorithms, and operational controls. Our goal is to provide strong, measurable, and where possible verifiable protection while preserving performance, energy efficiency, and usability. We welcome researchers with depth in one area and interest in contributing across the broader agenda.
NVIDIA is a leader in accelerated computing and AI systems. This role offers the opportunity to shape the security and safety foundations of emerging AI platforms, develop new approaches for AI-enabled secure system design and verification, and advance AI-powered cybersecurity in collaboration with research, product, and engineering teams.
What you'll be doing:
Advance the security, safety, and privacy of AI models and systems across the full lifecycle, including data collection, training, model and agent behavior, inference, deployment, and platform operations.
Develop AI-enabled methods to design, analyze, implement, and verify computer systems, including hardware architectures, system software, runtimes, compilers, and applications; rigorously evaluate security, safety, privacy, performance, and efficiency tradeoffs.
Advance AI for cybersecurity by developing techniques for vulnerability discovery, secure code generation and review, threat detection, incident analysis, security validation, and automated defense.
Collaborate across hardware, software, research, and product teams; publish original research; and help translate research advances into practical systems and developer capabilities.
What we need to see:
A Ph.D. in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, with a strong research background in security, AI/ML, computer architecture, operating systems, formal methods, programming languages and compilers, software systems, or other related areas.
A record of research excellence demonstrated through publications, open-source systems, patents, technology transfer, or substantial research collaborations.
Deep expertise in at least one of the three research areas—security of AI models and systems, AI-enabled design and verification of secure computer systems, or AI for cybersecurity—with the ability to connect that depth to challenges across the hardware/software stack.
Strong experimental research and prototyping skills, including the ability to build systems, define threat models, design meaningful evaluations, and analyze security and performance tradeoffs.
Strong programming skills in C, C++, Python, and/or relevant systems and machine-learning frameworks, along with clear written and verbal communication skills.
We are looking for creative, collaborative, and self-directed researchers who want to secure AI models and systems, use AI to help design and verify secure computer systems, and expand what AI can do for cybersecurity. Candidates do not need to be experts in all three areas, but should be excited to work across disciplines and help turn new ideas into high-impact research and technology.
NVIDIA has continuously reinvented itself over two decades. This is our life’s work — to amplify human imagination and intelligence. With highly competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package, NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers! We have some of the most hardworking, resourceful and dedicated people in the world working for us. Are you a security researcher who loves the challenge of exploring and crafting techniques that will impact our future products? If so, we want to hear from you!
Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and other objective job-related factors. The expected base salary range for this position is 168,000 USD – 264,500 USD.
You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.
Applications for this job will be accepted at least until November 10, 2026.
This posting is for an existing vacancy.
NVIDIA uses AI tools in its recruiting processes.
NVIDIA is committed to fostering an inclusive work environment and proud to be an equal opportunity employer. As we highly value diversity in our current and future employees, we do not discriminate (including in our hiring and promotion practices) on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any other characteristic protected by law.

NVIDIA is searching for a world-class generative AI researcher to join the fundamental generative AI research team at NVIDIA Research. We strive for research that pushes boundaries and builds the next generation of generative models but also has an impact on the world. We are interested in advancing generative AI methods for text, image, video, 3D, or scientific applications (i.e., GenAI4Science). You are expected to have a strong mathematical foundation and be capable of analyzing and developing novel models. The position will focus on fundamental research, with the freedom and bandwidth to conduct ground-breaking research. You will work within an amazing and collaborative research team that consistently publishes at the top venues in machine learning. You will be empowered to make contributions that create real-world impact.

What you'll be doing:
Research, design, and implement novel, large-scale generative AI methods.
Publish original research.
Collaborate with team members, research teams, as well as product teams.
Speak at conferences and events.
Transfer technology to product groups.

What we need to see:
Completing or recently completed a Ph.D. in Computer Science/Engineering, Statistics, etc. (or equivalent experience)
Excellent knowledge of the theory and practice of generative AI.
Experience in building generative models for text, image, 3D, video, multimodal, biology, chemistry, or material science data.
Excellent programming skills in some prototyping environments such as Python; C++ and parallel programming (e.g., CUDA).
Knowledge of deep learning frameworks, such as PyTorch.
Outstanding research track record.
Excellent communication skills.

We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us and, due to unprecedented growth, our best-in-class engineering teams are rapidly growing. If you're a creative and autonomous engineer with a real passion for computer architecture and technology, we want to hear from you!
